The user wants to list all chain identifiers present in the provided PDB structure.
I will scan the PDB records to find the chain identifiers.
The format for each ATOM record is:
ATOM      1  N   ARG A  26 ...
The chain identifier is the single letter in the 5th column (or after the residue name).
Looking at the records:
ATOM      1  N   ARG A  26 ... -> Chain A
...
ATOM    584  N   GLY B  23 ... -> Chain B
The structure only contains chains A and B.
Let's verify.
Scanning the text:
"ARG A", "PRO A", "LEU A", ... "MET A 100"
"GLY B 23", ... "HIS B 134"
So the chains are A and B.
The question asks for a comma-separated list of chain identifiers.
Format: FINAL: A, B
Check for any other chains? No.
Done.
